CREATE TABLE "public"."customers" (
  "active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "address" text,
  "contact_name" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "note" text,
  "phone" text,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "vat_tin" text,
  CONSTRAINT "PK_customers" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."sales_document_items" (
  "amount" numeric(18,4) DEFAULT '0'::numeric(18,4) NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "detail" text,
  "document_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "qty" numeric(18,4) DEFAULT '1'::numeric(18,4) NOT NULL,
  "unit_price" numeric(18,4) DEFAULT '0'::numeric(18,4) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "PK_sales_document_items" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."sales_documents" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "created_by" int4,
  "currency" "currency" DEFAULT 'USD'::"currency" NOT NULL,
  "customer_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "due_date" date,
  "exchange_rate" numeric(18,6) DEFAULT '1'::numeric(18,6) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "issue_date" date DEFAULT (CURRENT_DATE) NOT NULL,
  "journal_entry_id" int4,
  "notes" text,
  "number" text NOT NULL,
  "payment_method" "payment_method",
  "payment_reference" text,
  "source_id" int4,
  "status" "sales_doc_status" DEFAULT 'draft'::"sales_doc_status" NOT NULL,
  "subtotal" numeric(18,4) DEFAULT '0'::numeric(18,4) NOT NULL,
  "total" numeric(18,4) DEFAULT '0'::numeric(18,4) NOT NULL,
  "total_usd" numeric(18,4) DEFAULT '0'::numeric(18,4) NOT NULL,
  "type" "sales_doc_type" NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "valid_until" date,
  "vat_amount" numeric(18,4) DEFAULT '0'::numeric(18,4) NOT NULL,
  "vat_rate" numeric(18,4) DEFAULT '0'::numeric(18,4) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "PK_sales_documents" PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "sales_documents_exchange_rate_positive" CHECK ((exchange_rate > (0)::numeric))
)
